headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment on Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited notified the NSE of timely interest payment on its publicly issued, listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDs), confirming compliance with Regulation 57 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
implication: Routine disclosure of debt servicing compliance signals operational stability and adherence to SEBI's mandatory continuous disclosure regime for listed debt instruments-material for institutional investors and credit rating agencies monitoring the issuer's covenant performance.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company (NBFC), issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures via public offering and listed them on stock exchanges. The company has made a timely interest payment on these securities and filed the requisite Regulation 57 intimation with the NSE to disclose this event to the market. The filing confirms the company's debt servicing capacity and adherence to debenture covenants at the disclosure date.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 57
framework.note: central – Mandatory continuous disclosure by listed companies of material events, including debt servicing; forms the statutory basis for this intimation.
Empowers stock exchanges to enforce listing rules and disclosure requirements; NSE authority to receive and publish intimations.

framework.ref: Reserve Bank of India (Reserve Bank of India) Non-Banking Financial Companies Scale-Based Regulation (NBFC-SBR) Framework, 2022 (as amended)
framework.note: Governs NBFC capital adequacy, liquidity, and disclosure obligations; contextualizes issuer's regulatory standing.
Restricts public deposits by companies; applies to public debenture issuance and listing framework.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Debentures and Securitised Debt Instruments) Regulations, 2021
framework.note: Prescribes rules for public issue, listing, and post-listing obligations for NCDs; directly applicable to this SRNCD programme.

framework.ref: National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) Listing Agreement & Circulars
framework.note: NSE-specific continuous disclosure norms and formats for listed debt securities; governs the filing channel and timeline.

framework.ref: Reserve Bank of India Master Direction – Non-Banking Financial Company – Systemically Important Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC-SI) and Large NBFCs Directions, 2023
framework.note: If Sammaan Capital is classified as NBFC-SI, mandates enhanced governance and disclosure; status-dependent.

conditions: Timely interest payment made on SRNCDs as per terms of debenture trust deed
approvals: Public issue and listing approval (historical, prior to this date)
structure.novel: Routine compliance disclosure; no novel structure.

triggers.note: Mandatory intimation to exchange upon material debt servicing events.

triggers.law: SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Debentures and Securitised Debt Instruments) Regulations, 2021
triggers.note: Post-listing obligation to maintain investor confidence in listed debt via timely payment disclosure.
